# Benzinga

> Benzinga is a financial intelligence platform providing real-time market news, trading ideas, stock quotes, and investment tools for active traders and investors.

Benzinga offers a comprehensive suite of trading and investment products including the Benzinga Pro premium platform, Edge dashboard for portfolio tracking, and APIs for financial market data. The site aggregates real-time quotes, analyst ratings, and market-moving news across stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies.

## Key Topics

- Real-time market data
- Trading ideas
- Stock quotes
- ETF tracking
- Financial news
- Analyst ratings
- Benzinga Pro
- Benzinga Edge
- Investment tracking
- Cryptocurrency
- Premarket movers
- Market APIs
- Portfolio analytics
- Premium services
- Financial analytics

## Core Platforms

- [Benzinga Homepage](https://www.benzinga.com): Trading ideas, real-time news, stock quotes, and market data
- [Benzinga Pro](https://pro.benzinga.com): Fast market news, alerts, and trading tools for active traders
- [Benzinga Edge Dashboard](https://www.benzinga.com/edge/dashboard): Portfolio tracking and stock analysis dashboard

## Market Data & Quotes

- [SPY ETF Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SPY): Real-time S&P 500 ETF quotes, charts, news, and analyst ratings
- [QQQ ETF Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/QQQ): Real-time Nasdaq 100 ETF quotes, charts, news, and analyst ratings
- [DIA ETF Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/DIA): Real-time Dow Jones ETF quotes, charts, and tracking
- [GLD Gold ETF Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/GLD): Real-time gold ETF quotes, charts, news, and market data
- [TLT Treasury Bond ETF Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TLT): Real-time treasury bond ETF quotes, charts, and analytics
- [Bitcoin/USD Quote](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BTC-USD): Real-time Bitcoin/USD quotes, charts, news, and price history

## News & Market Coverage

- [Premarket Movers & News](https://www.benzinga.com/premarket): Premarket trading coverage with movers, news, earnings, and futures data

## Developer Tools & APIs

- [Financial Market Data APIs](https://www.benzinga.com/apis): APIs for market data, news feeds, and financial analytics integration

## Business Solutions

- [Benzinga Advertising](https://advertise.benzinga.com): Advertising platform for investor marketing and sponsored content

## Optional

- [Contributor Portal](https://contributor.benzinga.com/contributor-onboarding): Benzinga contributor login and onboarding portal
